About_&_Key_Points:
About
Incorporated in 1987, Hester Biosciences Ltd is one of India’s leading animal healthcare companies and a major manufacturer of poultry and animal vaccines, including a leading position in PPR and Goat Pox vaccines.
[1]
Key Points
Business Overview
[1]
Hester operates an integrated animal healthcare platform across
Poultry Healthcare and Animal Healthcare
, offering vaccines, therapeutics, feed supplements, diagnostics, and petcare products. It's portfolio serves poultry farmers, livestock producers, veterinarians, and pet owners through a combination of R&D, manufacturing, quality systems, technical services, and field support.
